story.title: Story 6: Startup Validation and Assignment Config

result.planSummary: Implemented Story 6: Startup Validation and Assignment Config. Added loadAssignments (config loading with shipped defaults and user overrides, fail-loud on incomplete/unknown/placeholder), validateReachable (registry probe for existence and configured auth), report (UI + headless-safe health diagnostics). Integrated into session_start hook after instance creation. All 7 assignment kinds validated before first derivation use; unreachable lanes reported with kind+provider/model+fix; capture continues through validation failures.
